book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kanguakinya bhandu bhalindakile na mahundo gha Afalisayu
Mbole Yesu kakiaghombela bhala bhandu atangalo papamu na ahundwa bhake bhaabheghite apo,
“Ahunda bha Malaghilo na Afalisayo ndo bhaakamuhitwe makakala gha kufwambula Malaghilo gha Musa,
Habhu, mungunoghwa kuayitikila na kutenda kyohele kyaabhaghombela. Peni nkotoke kutenda ghala ghaaghatenda, kiyaha bhombe angutenda ng'obhe ghala ghaaghalandamiha.
Bhombe bhanguyibhopa mihiho mikulu na kuhibhika mu makombi gha bhandu, peni bhene angulema nga kuyikamula kwa hikonji ghabhe.

Bhombe bhangutenda ndendelo yabhe hyoha ngati abhonekane na bhandu, ghabhe bhanguhwala himatiko hinakubhegha na Malembo gha Malaghilo muhibhungi hyabhe na mumabhoko na kutaliha hihundo hya mapinda ghabhe.
Bhangupala kutama mu hiteho hya pahala pa kuhokamilwa muchekwa na muhila hiteho hya kuhokamilwa munu munyumba hya kukonganila,
Bhangupala kujambuhwa mumagulio na bhagupala bhandu bhaakeme ‘Nhunda.’
Peni bhandu akotoke kuakema mwenga ‘Nhunda.’ Kiyaha mabhoha mwenga ndo afwasi bhangu na nhunda ywenu ndo yumu ghweka.
Na nkotoke kunkema ywohele ‘Tate’ mu nnima aghu kiyaha mmegha na Tate yumu, naywo kabhegha kunane.
Bhandu akotoke kuakema mwenga ‘Hilongohi.’ Kiyaha mmegha naywo kilongohi yumu ghweka, naywo ndo Kilisto.
Ywombe ywakabhegha nkulu mu mwenga yibhegha mbaka kabheghe nndumitumi ywenu.
Kiyaha mundu ywohele ywakaliyinula katahuluhwa na mundu ywohele ywakalihuluha katayinulwa.”
Yesu kangughulakalila ufyangu

“Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha Malaghilo na Afalisayo, maafyangu, kiyaha munguatatila bhandu nlyango ghwa Ghubhutwa ghwa kunane, kunu mabhene munguyingila ng'obhe, na bhala bhaapala kuyingila munguakanikiha.

Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha Malaghilo Afalisayo, maafyangu, mungulyegha munyumba ya adala alekwa, kunu mungulitenda handa bhamaha, na kwa ufyangu munguyupa mayupo mandandamaho. Habhu, maamokola kihyatu kikulu.”

“Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha malaghilo na Afalisayo maafyangu, kiyaha mungutindila mu milima na kuyomboka mahibha ngati kuntenda mundu yumu kabheghe Nnyahudi, na pakatenda kala kubhegha mwana ywa kumambe mala mbili kyanalumu.”

“Kibhabhone mwenga hilongohi maangabhona. Mwenga mungulongela, ‘Handa mundu pakalapa kwa lihina lya Nyumba ya Chapanga, kilapo akyo kyayaghi, peni pakalapa kwa lihina lya sahabu ya mu Nyumba ya Chapanga, mundu aywo kabhopwa mu kilapo akyo’
Mwenga mangalola ahilamahala. Ndo kyoki kiibhegha kikulu kupitingana kingi, yila sahabu ebu yila Nyumba ya Chapanga yinakutenda ayo sahabu yibheghe ya Chapanga?
Kangi mungulongela, ‘Mundu pakalapa kwa kindambi kya kuyambikila, chepa kilibhi, peni pakalapa kwa nyambi yiibhegha mukila kindambi, mundu aywo kangubhopwa na kilapo akyo.’
Mwenga mangabhona. Ndo kyoki kiibhegha kikulu mu ahyo, yila nyambi, ebu kila kindambi kya nyambi kiitenda ayo nyambi yibheghe ya Chapanga?
Habhu, mundu ywakalapa kwa kindami, kangulapa kwa akyo kindambi na ghoha ghaabheghiti unane ghwake.
Naywo mundu ywakalapa kwa Nyumba ya Chapanga, kangulapa kwa ayo Nyumba ya Chapanga na kwa aywo ywakatama mu Nyumba ayo.
Naywo yunakulapa kwa kunane kwa Chapanga, kangulapa kwa kiteho kya Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga na kwa aywo yaakatama mu kiteho akyo.”

“Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha malaghilo na Akaafalisayu, maafyangu. Kiyaha munguatenda bhandu atule matulo gha lifungu lya kumi hata kwa manyahi ghanakunungila nyanyi, bisali na lihambanyungu peni munguyileka milando mikulu ya Malaghilo, handa bhula kutenda gha maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, luhungu na kuhyubhalila. Agho ghanguakwiliha kughatenda kyanga kughalibhalila ghangi.
Mwenga hilongohi mangabhona, mungubhuha libhembe mukiywegho na mungummila nnyama ngamia.”
“Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha malaghilo na Afalisayo, maafyangu, kiyaha mungughulula nnobho na kipumbulu kwa panje, peni nkati mmema hilibhi muyimokolite kwa upoka na ghwimi.
Mwenga maafalisayo mangabhona, ng'ulule huti nkati ya nnobho na hipumbulu, ndo panje paabhegha nyanyi.”

“Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha Malaghilo na Afalisayu afyangu. Mungulihwana na mandogholo ghaalembitwe chokaa kya panje ghangubhonekana gha nyanyi peni nkati ghabhegha na mihupa ya bhaahweghite na hinyakali hyoha.
Ubhwabhu abhu, na mwenga kya panje mungubhonekana mmegha bha maha peni nkati mmema ufyangu na uhokelo.”
Yesu kangulongela kulinga toso ya Afalisayo
“Kibhabhone mwenga ahunda bha malaghilo na Afalisayo maafyangu. Mungughachengela mandogholo gha ambuye na kughalemba mandogholo gha bhaabheghite bha maha.
Na mungulongela, ‘Handa tungabheghite mumajubha gha aghohi bhetu, tungabheghite ng'obhe papamu nabho ng'obhe mu kuakoma ambuye.’
Habhu munguyilimiha mabhene kukita mwenga ndo bhana bha bhandu bhaabhakomiti ambuye.
Basi, mughumemekehe nteko ghwa uhakata ghwa atate bhenu.
Mwenga kibheleko kya mayoka bhana lusungu, mayibhutuka bhuli toso ya mwoto ghwangahimika?

Kya habhu, nnole nunguayeghela ambuye na bhaabheghiti bha maha na bhaabheghite na malango na ahunda. Amoo bhangi matabhakoma na kubhabhamba, amoo bhabhe mutabhahyata hinjupunjupu mu nyumba hyenu hya kukonganila na amoo bhabhe mutabhabhingabhinga kuhuma mukitami kimu mbaka kitami kingi.

Habhu, ghula mwahi ghwa bhaabheghite bha maha bhoha, ghuuyitikite munnima aghu, kutandila mwahi ghwa Abeli, ywakatendite ng'obhe uhakata, mbaka mwahi ghwa Sakaliya mwana ywa Balakia, yumunkomite pakati ya pakya Chapanga na kinambi kya lihabha, yabhahikila unani mwa mwenga.
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela agha ghoha ghaahika mukibheleko aki.”
Yesu kangualilila Bhandu bha ku Yeslusalemu

“Mwenga mabhandu bha Yelusalemu, mubhakomiti ambuye na kuatuta kwa malibho bhala bhaalaghilitwe kwa mwenga. Pakiki nikilitumba kuakungana bhana bhako, handa bhula nguku pakungana bhana bhake mu mapabhatila yake, peni ghukilema.
Ghulole kaayileka Nyumba yenu yibheghe mang'obha.
Kiyaha nunguaghombela, mamona kangi ng'obhe mbaka lijubha lila panlongela, ‘Kanemelwa ywene yunakuhika kwa Lihina lya Bambo.’”
